idle: a person stands still, breathing calmly and shifting their weight slightly
relax: a person lowers both arms to their sides and stands relaxed
wave: a person stands in place and waves hello with their right hand
nod: a person stands still and nods their head yes
shake_head: a person stands still and shakes their head no
bow: a person bows politely, then stands back up
shrug: a person stands in place and shrugs both shoulders
think: a person stands still with one hand on their chin, thinking
stretch: a person stands and stretches both arms up over their head
clap: a person stands in place and claps their hands
cheer: a person raises both arms in the air and cheers
point: a person stands still and points forward with their right hand
cross_arms: a person stands still with their arms crossed
look_around: a person stands in place and looks around to the left and to the right
yawn: a person covers their mouth with one hand and yawns
sway: a person sways happily from side to side
hands_on_hips: a person stands with both hands on their hips
squat: a person squats down with both knees bent and stays low
raise_arms: a person slowly raises both arms straight up over their head
raise_left_arm: a person raises their left arm straight up
raise_right_arm: a person raises their right arm straight up
arms_forward: a person raises both arms forward to shoulder height
motion_walk: a person walks forward naturally, swinging their arms
motion_run: a person jogs forward at a steady pace
motion_run_stop: a person jogs forward, slows down and comes to a stop
motion_walk_stop: a person walks forward, slows down and comes to a stop
motion_turn: a person turns around in place
motion_sit_down: a person sits down on a chair
motion_sit: a person sits on a chair with their hands on their lap
motion_stand_up: a person stands up from a chair
motion_type: a person sits at a desk and types on a keyboard
motion_lie_down: a person sits on the edge of a bed, swings their legs up and lies down on their back
motion_lie: a person lies still on their back, sleeping
motion_get_up: a person lying on their back sits up, swings their legs off the bed and stands up
motion_open_door: a person reaches forward and pulls a door open with their right hand
motion_reach: a person reaches forward with their right hand and takes something from a shelf
motion_eat: a person stands and eats food from one hand
motion_tidy: a person bends over and straightens a blanket on a bed with both hands
